description_expanded: ABOUT LEEWARD 1-7: Welcome to Leeward I-7, a charming beach-front condominium located on the southern side of the picturesque 30A area. This lovely unit features a luxurious King master bedroom, two hall bunks, and a sleeper sofa, accommodating up to four guests comfortably. Ideally situated, guests can delight in mornings on the sandy shores and afternoons exploring the diverse array of boutiques and dining options that line the stunning 30A coastal stretch, conveniently accessible by bike or car. Leeward I-7 is a perfect retreat for a couple or small family seeking a week of seaside relaxation or a romantic escape. The spacious king master bedroom boasts a flat-screen TV and an en-suite full bathroom, offering utmost comfort and convenience. As you pass by the hallway bunks and enter the main living area, spectacular ocean vistas can be enjoyed from the well-appointed kitchen and living room. Guests can savor a cup of coffee while watching the sunrise or unwind with an evening drink as the sun sets over the horizon. Please note that parking is limited to one car with a permit for your convenience. ABOUT THE AREA: Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community located along Scenic Highway 30A in the Florida Panhandle. Situated between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, Seagrove Beach epitomizes the laid-back and picturesque beach lifestyle that the area is known for. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, emerald green waters, and towering sand dunes, Seagrove Beach offers a serene and relaxed ambiance that attracts visitors looking for a peaceful getaway. The beach in Seagrove is perfect for swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and simply enjoying the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. In addition to its beautiful beach, Seagrove Beach is surrounded by natural beauty, including rare coastal dune lakes, pine forests, and state parks. Visitors can explore hiking and biking trails, go birdwatching, or take a leisurely walk along the scenic coastline to appreciate the area's unique ecosystem. Seagrove Beach is also home to a variety of charming beach cottages, luxury vacation rentals, boutique shops, and delicious restaurants serving fresh seafood and local cuisine. The community has a laid-back and friendly vibe, making it a favorite destination for families, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts looking to unwind and reconnect with nature. Along Scenic Highway 30A, visitors can explore neighboring beach communities, each with its own distinct character and amenities. From art galleries and coastal dune lakes to live music events and farmers markets, there is always something to see and do along this scenic stretch of coastline. Overall, Seagrove Beach is a hidden gem along Scenic Highway 30A, offering a perfect blend of natural beauty, relaxation, and Southern hospitality that captures the essence of the Florida Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Leeward private beach access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * 8 minute bike ride to Seaside * Directly on the beach * Incredible gulf views PARKING: * Free Parking up to 1 Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation. * Must Be 25 years or older. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
